name: inventdb-legal-demo
description: InventDB Legal demo films (3 and 5 minute cuts), rendered from code with Remotion.

scripts.capture: cd ../../frontend && npx playwright test --config ../Demo/studio/capture/playwright.config.mjs scenes law intro
scripts.music: python scripts/music.py 180 public/music-3min.wav && python scripts/music.py 300 public/music-5min.wav
scripts.build: npm run data && npm run capture && npm run music && npm run subtitles && npm run render:short && npm run render:long
